decisions.reason: The bleaching tray blank line has several models and its own page, so the firm has invested in it and committed to it visibly, and it fits the core dental thermoforming business, which makes dropping it a write-off that would need justifying.
The PETG thermoforming blank was presented on its own page in both years and is a staple material in the firm's established thermoforming range, so persistence is likely.

The UV-curing lacquer was only mentioned rather than featured, so little public commitment is at stake, but as a low-cost consumable that supports the firm's workflows it will likely be kept unless results clearly fail.

The firm dropped the sister earmold line early, yet this multi-model hearing protection line survived and fits its custom-device manufacturing and digital production direction, so management would likely attribute weak results to temporary causes and keep it.
